# T-2: Encapsulate definition access

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Replace raw definition data exports with definition-side query APIs for flow and task definition access.

## Acceptance Criteria
- FLOW_DEFINITION and TASK_DEFINITION are not exported as raw data.
- Definition-side APIs provide node lookup, task node lookup, leaf id collection, phase/action mapping, definition order, active node lookup, maxAttempts, sideEffects, and runtime step resolution.
- Callers no longer pass raw definition data into generic resolver functions.

## Implementation Notes
Use deep module design: callers ask intent-specific APIs instead of knowing the definition data shape.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local static tests assert raw exports are absent and representative modules import/call definition APIs instead.
